Class ReportsPanel

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
javax.swing.JPanel
sakaboba.ui.ReportsPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable, Accessible
public class ReportsPanel extends JPanel
Manager report controls, sortable results and the product usage chart. Construct and use this panel on the Swing event dispatch thread. Database calls run in SwingWorker tasks; controls are disabled while a task is running. Validation and database failures are displayed in the status label.

Changing a report or date clears stale results. X-report dates are fixed to today; other reports accept inclusive ISO date ranges. The panel adapts report rows into BarChart.Bar values, so the chart knows nothing about SQL columns.
